verdict.rationale: First-party WorkOS material lists passkeys and magic auth as built-in AuthKit sign-in methods alongside passwords, social login and SSO. It also describes passwordless auth via a six-digit code sent by email, which covers both halves of the story. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on passkey/WebAuthn setup and configuration, detail on magic-link vs. OTP behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
